items.title: Dalton Richards Interview, 1961-03-16
items.q: If it wasn't...if it wasn't me, it was Craig. A fella named James Craig. He was a piano player.

ctx.x: Well, the money wasn't much, but the fun was there, you understand? And they had, uh, at that time about two or three fellas that were doing the same thing. We played house parties. If it wasn't...if it wasn't me, it was Craig. A fella named James Craig. He was a piano player.
But how old were you when you started playing at those parties?
